text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are hereby appropriated out of any
funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated:
STUDENT PENSIONADOS.
(a) For the payment of traveling expenses and allowances of not to exceed ten student pensionados to be
selected from the Mountain Province and the Provinces of Agu-san and Nueva Vizcaya to pursue a course in
training for teaching; subject to the provisions contained in Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and eighty-three
of the Philippine Legislature: Provided, That such students shall not be subject to the scholarship requirement
of said Act and may receive training hereby provided for in any school of the Philippine
Islands selected by the Director of Education
TEACHER PENSIONADOS.
(b) For the payment of traveling expenses and allowances of not to exceed six teacher pensionados to be
selected from the Mountain Province and the Provinces of Agu-san and Nueva Vizcaya; subject to the
provisions contained in Act Numbered Nineteen hundred and eighty-four of the Philippine Legislature
1,250.00
__________
Total of appropriations by this Act
2,750.00

This Act shall take effect as of June first, nine-teen hundred and fourteen.
Enacted, March 14, 1914.
